What should I do if the tracking never updates?
Tracking links typically update the evening before or the morning of delivery. Some couriers (like Royal Mail) don’t scan until the parcel is out for delivery, so it can look “stuck” until the day itself.
What to do:
Check your order confirmation for the delivery date and open the tracking link directly on the courier’s website.
Watch for updates up to 9pm on the delivery day—late scans are common.
If there’s still no update by the end of the delivery day, give it until the following morning.
If there’s no movement 24 hours after the expected delivery date, contact us and we’ll investigate with the courier right away.
If you’d like me to check your order now, share your order number and postcode and I’ll take a look.
